2026-09-29 03:58:25.421514 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-09-29 03:58:25.422084 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-09-29 03:58:25.422113 | controller |
2026-09-29 03:58:25.422121 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-29 03:58:25.422127 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-29 03:58:25.422134 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-29 03:58:25.422140 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-29 03:58:25.422146 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
